name: Community Charitable Foundation Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
A detailed packet is available for review at www.beverlyhills.org

  City of Beverly Hills
  Community Charitable Foundation Board of Directors
  Special Meeting

  Video Teleconference
  Call in: (916) 235-1420 or (888) 468-1995
  Participant Pin: 872120
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Thursday, August 6, 2020
  3:00 PM

  TELEPHONIC/VIDEO CONFERENCE MEETING

  Pursuant to Executive Order N-25-20 members of the Beverly Hills City Council and staff may
  participate in this meeting via a teleconference. In the interest of maintaining appropriate social
  distancing, members of the public can participate by listening to the Special Meeting at (916) 235-
  1420 or (888) 468-1195 (participant code 872120) and offer comment through email at
  commentccf@beverlyhills.org

  AGENDA

  OPEN MEETING

  ROLL CALL

  COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE AUDIENCE
  Members of the public may address the Foundation Board regarding any items not on the
  Agenda that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Foundation. By State law, the
  Foundation may not discuss or vote on items not on the Agenda.

  1.  Approval of Foundation Board of Directors Meeting Minutes
  (a)  February 11, 2020 Board Meeting

  2.  City of Beverly Hills Community Charitable Foundation (CBHCCF)
  Report of Donations and Financial Statements
  (a)  Schedule of Donations to be Approved
  (b)  Schedule of All Donations Received to Date
  (c)  Schedule of All Donations Received to Date to be Transferred to City
  (d)  Balance Sheet and Income Statement

  3.  Review and Amend City of Beverly Hills Community Charitable Foundation
  Bylaws

  4.  Request by Chair Fisher to discuss Buck Heling Fund and Burton Green
  Scholarship

  5.  Update on Park Bench Program

  COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE BOARD

  ADJOURNMENT

  Members of the public may listen to this meeting telephonically at (916) 235-1420 or (888) 468-1195 (participant code
872120). Public comment can be offered electronically prior to the meeting by emailing commentccf@beverlyhills.org. If
 you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable modification or accommodation pursuant to the Americans
  with Disabilities Act (ADA), please contact (310) 285-2531 prior to the meeting for assistance.
